# Nama ERP Data Model

> Machine-readable database schema for Nama ERP (https://www.namasoft.com). Every entity (database table) has a JSON file describing its columns, Arabic/English labels, referenced tables, enum types, and detail (child line) tables.

How to use this site programmatically:

- Entity list (all entities with names, tables, modules, and detail tables): https://dm.namasoft.com/dm-json/index.json
- Entity schema: https://dm.namasoft.com/dm-json/{EntityName}.json
- Enum values: https://dm.namasoft.com/dm-json/enums/{EnumName}.json
- Human-readable page: https://dm.namasoft.com/modules/{module}/{EntityName}.html

Field entries use: id (property name), column (database column; "columns" array for multi-column generic references), ar/en (labels), type (field type), refTo (referenced entity for Reference fields), enum (enum type name for Enum fields).
